answer: Histories are stored in dawn, checked in cipher, and onyx makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 3 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 2343 identities would post 3728 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
